base_prompt: I want to keep a small balcony pleasant, but I dislike spending weekends on maintenance. Suggest priorities for arranging the space. Please answer in roughly 160 words.
text: Prioritize comfort, durability, and low maintenance over a crowded or highly decorative layout. Start with one comfortable chair or a compact loveseat, paired with a small folding table so the balcony remains flexible and easy to clean. Choose weather-resistant materials such as powder-coated metal, treated wood, or outdoor-rated woven plastic, and use removable cushions in dark or patterned fabrics that hide dirt. Add shade with a retractable umbrella, light canopy, or outdoor curtain, depending on your building’s rules. For greenery, select a few hardy container plants suited to your balcony’s sunlight and climate, such as succulents, herbs, lavender, or ornamental grasses. Use large pots with drainage reservoirs or self-watering planters to reduce watering, and group them near a railing or wall for efficient care. Keep the floor mostly open, using a washable outdoor rug only if it will dry quickly. Finally, include discreet storage for cushions and tools, and reserve a clear path for sweeping, watering, and occasional seasonal tidying.
